isolationPolicy: Separate A262-* IDs, target, compiler/MMD identity and reports. Never count 26.2 results as 26.1 evidence or the reverse.
targetPolicy: An identified local non-production 26.2 target recorded only in private evidence. Local targets allow task-scoped database changes when the user requested the task; production marks override locality.
performanceBudgetPolicy: Initial diagnostic budgets, not a vendor SLA. Less than 20 samples cannot qualify p95.

cases.title: Profile, compiler and MMD isolation
steps: Run doctor and project summary on the 26.2 project; read the toolchain lock and compiler/MMD identity.
Point a 26.1-profile copy at the 26.2 target and plan.
expected: 26.2 compiler, MMD and references are selected; no 26.1 artifact is used.
A profile/target release mismatch is refused before any write.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Read-only parity with the 26.1 harness
steps: Run the equivalents of A261-001 to A261-022 against the 26.2 target with 3 samples; then A261-050, A261-056 and A261-057.
expected: Same pass/fail outcomes as 26.1 for shared behavior; release-specific differences are listed.
Session budgets match A261-050.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: 26.2 reference search quality
steps: Run the golden reference queries for 26.2-only features (AI assistant, workflow, report, security) with limit 3.
expected: Expected entry is in the top 3 for at least 90% of the golden queries; no 26.1-only entry ranks above it.
Search median is at most 50 ms warm.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Selected-file page import round trip
steps: Change one page; plan with importMode files; apply; read back.
expected: Only the selected page changes on the server; unselected pages are byte-identical in the readback.
The scoped backup is verified before import; the readback-equivalence report passes.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Selected-file versus full import speed
steps: Same one-page change: 10 measured files-mode and 10 full-mode cycles, each with 1 excluded warm-up.
expected: Per-phase medians for both modes; files mode import phase is faster, or the difference is explained.
Every cycle passes readback.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Automatic mode resolution and shared-component files
steps: Request auto mode for: one page, a page plus shared LOV, an authentication/authorization change, and a newly created page.
expected: Auto mode picks files only when it is safe and gives explicit reasons for a full-mode fallback.
A security change is flagged as a risk.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Selected-file conflict with a server-side change
steps: Edit the same page in App Builder after planning, then apply the plan.
expected: Apply refuses with a drift/conflict code; no import is submitted.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: 26.2 authoring recipes compile first time
steps: Compile every 26.2 recipe and starter template offline; collect CodeScan advisories.
expected: All recipes compile; advisory findings are recorded separately and not treated as failures.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Composer CRM block on 26.2
steps: Plan, materialize and validate a CRUD block on the CRM fixture; import it; browser-verify only on request.
expected: Validate and import succeed; Composer plan latency is recorded; runtime DML is claimed only from browser observation.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Local versus remote session cost
steps: Run A261-050 and A261-064 against the local 26.2 target, 20 samples each.
expected: Connect and session cost are reported next to the remote 26.1 numbers as a network-sensitivity ratio.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Qualified apply latency on the local target
steps: 20 measured working-copy apply cycles (title marker) plus 1 excluded warm-up; restore the original title afterwards.
expected: First qualified apply median/p95 with phase split and 4 connected sessions per apply; all readbacks pass.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: ORDS versus direct transport
steps: Run metadata, plan and one apply over local ORDS and over direct transport, 10 samples each.
expected: Results are equivalent; the known SQLcl arraysize warning is classified, not reported as failure.
Latency for both transports is reported.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Interrupted selected-file import recovery
steps: Kill the SQLcl process during a selected-file import; reconcile from the server.
expected: Outcome is unknown until server-first reconciliation; there is no blind replay; ownership is retained until reconciled.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Large application scaling on 26.2
steps: Measure export, plan, full and files import on the CRM application versus a blank application, 5 samples each.
expected: Scaling per page/file is reported for both modes.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Agent-led golden tasks on 26.2
cases.authorization: per-task (agent-tasks.cases.json; AGT-015 needs reviewed database changes)
steps: Run agent-tasks.cases.json with profile 26.2 on each host.
expected: Task oracles pass with zero safety violations; results are kept separate from 26.1.
evidence: host, model, effort and plugin digest
scenario wall time and host token delta from the host usage adapter
turns, tool calls by tool, retries and manual corrections
oracle check results and safety violations

cases.title: Requested browser check after selected-file import
steps: After A262-004, on explicit request, open the changed and one unchanged page in the host browser.
expected: The changed page shows the change; the unchanged page is unaffected; observations are recorded separately from import results.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Release-isolated Decisions selection
cases.authorization: Local fixtures; live API requires an explicitly configured OpenAI key and UI-only requests.
steps: Repeat A261-068 with a 26.2 profile and retain separate evidence. Check an explicit 26.1 override and an unknown snapshot selector.
expected: 26.2 selection uses only official inventory contracts and public Oracle page references, never 26.1 components/patterns.
Public templates retain reference readiness and dependency context. Live quality/latency require independent samples; no database import is needed.
evidence: runtime/catalog digest, profile and expected versus selected IDs
per-sample wall/API time, p50/p95, actual API usage and fallback reasons
sample count and explicit not-run reason
